name: ui-stepper
description: Bootstrap 6 stepper: numbered steps with track, vertical or horizontal (also by container width), active and themed steps, overflow scrolling, full width, alignment, link or clickable steps.

descriptions.--bs-stepper-bg: Circle and track of open steps.
descriptions.--bs-stepper-active-color: Number colour of active steps (theme: its contrast).
descriptions.--bs-stepper-active-bg: Circle and track of active steps (theme: its bg).
descriptions.--bs-stepper-align-items: Vertical alignment of circle and content (unset: center).
